cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Rural Development Ministry has notified the Grievance Redressal Rules, 2026 under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 (PIB, The Hindu, HT, TOI). Complaints must be resolved within 15 days, with a preliminary inquiry within seven working days (TOI). Grievances can be filed in person, by speed post, on a designated digital platform, through telephone helplines, or any other mode a state decides (The Hindu). All complaints must be recorded, complainants get a hearing, and unresolved issues are escalated (TOI). The officer levels for escalation were not in the summaries we read.
